description: A utility module for versioned, per-organization salted password hashing and verification, supporting multiple algorithms (Argon2id, bcrypt, scrypt) with fallback mechanisms and tenant salt management.

methods.name: getPepper
methods.description: Retrieves the global optional pepper string from environment variables.

methods.name: buildHashInput
methods.description: Constructs the input string for hashing based on version and tenant info.

methods.name: hashPasswordV2
methods.description: Hashes a password using the preferred v2 scheme, selecting the strongest available algorithm.

methods.name: hashPasswordV1
methods.description: Hashes a password using legacy static salt with scrypt, for verification of existing hashes.

methods.name: verifyPassword
methods.description: Verifies a password against stored hash, determining algorithm and version.

methods.name: compareHash
methods.description: Compares input with stored hash using the appropriate algorithm.

methods.name: ensureTenantOrgSalt
methods.description: Ensures tenant has an orgSalt, generating and saving one if missing.

methods.name: hashPassword
methods.description: Hashes a password with specified version (defaults to v2).

methods.name: verifyAndMigrate
methods.description: Verifies password and migrates legacy hashes to current scheme if needed.
